description.short: Bala Adventure & Watersports is a family-run watersports and multi-activity centre on the shores of Llyn Tegid (Bala Lake) in Eryri National Park. An RYA Training Centre with an AALA licence, it offers kayaking, canoeing, windsurfing, sailing, powerboating, SUP, white-water rafting, rock climbing, abseiling, gorge walking, and guided mountain biking — serving families, school groups, and corporate teams year-round.

activities.activitiesSource: https://www.balawatersports.com/adventure-activities-watersports/ — cross-checked against AALA licensed activities at https://aala.hse.gov.uk/aala/provider_detail.php?ref_no=R0679
activities.activitiesNote: AALA licence covers: Abseiling, Canoeing, Canyoning, Gorge scrambling, Hill and mountain walking, Improvised rafting, Kayaking, Mega/giant SUP, Rock climbing, Sailing (excl. foiling), SUP (excl. foiling), Windsurfing (excl. foiling). Powerboating appears on the website but is not listed in the AALA activities — it is RYA-regulated separately. Verify before publishing powerboating as a licensed adventure activity.

openingHours.season: Year-round. High season April–October. Closed approximately two weeks over Christmas.
openingHours.dailyHoursNote: Per Google Maps data (via Wanderlog, accessed June 2026): Mon/Wed/Fri 9AM–4PM, Tue/Thu 10AM–4PM, Sat–Sun 9AM–5PM. Office hours 9AM–5PM. Equipment hire starts from 10AM on the hour. Hours are subject to seasonal variation — verify directly with operator before publishing.
